query:
SELECT
            path,
            COUNT(*) as "requests!",
            COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms), 0.0) as "p95_ms!"
        FROM api_request_logs
        WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '24 hours'
        AND api_key_id IN (SELECT id FROM api_keys WHERE user_id = $1)
        GROUP BY path
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 10
